title: Fuzzy selective state model for forecasting the dynamics of consumer preferences
abstract: arXiv:2610.41879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider forecasting the dynamics of consumer preferences of retail chain customers. A customer's preference is described by a triangular fuzzy number. The evolution of the preference over time is governed by a Mamba-type selective state space model whose hidden state is a triangular number, with computations carried out in M.G.~Matveev's two-component algebra of fuzzy numbers. The recurrence parameters are computed from crisp features, while the fuzzy part of the model remains linear with non-negative coefficients. We show that the state then always remains a proper triangular number and is a convex combination of past observations, so that the fuzziness of the forecast does not accumulate over time and the algebraic computations coincide with Zadeh's extension principle. translated_title: 用于预测消费者偏好动态的模糊选择性状态模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究零售连锁店顾客消费者偏好动态的预测问题。顾客的偏好由一个三角模糊数来描述。偏好随时间的演化由一个Mamba类型的选择性状态空间模型控制，其隐状态为三角数，相关计算在M.G. Matveev的模糊数二分量代数中进行。递归参数由清晰特征计算得出，而模型的模糊部分保持线性且系数非负。我们证明，在此条件下状态始终保持为一个正常的三角数，并且是过去观测值的凸组合，因此预测的模糊性不会随时间累积，且代数计算与Zadeh扩展原理相一致。在一个包含竞争对手促销和顾客转换行为的合成示例中，一个轻量级的107参数模型达到了预测中心值为……的平均绝对误差。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于模糊数二分量代数的Mamba型选择性状态空间模型，用三角模糊数刻画零售顾客偏好动态，并证明预测模糊性不会随时间累积，仅用107个参数的轻量模型即可实现准确的消费者偏好预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Mamba-type selective state space model operating on triangular fuzzy numbers via Matveev's two-component algebra, proves that forecast fuzziness does not accumulate over time, and achieves accurate consumer preference forecasting with a lightweight 107-parameter model.
